property_summary: For any inputs, the reference contract always calls the callee function with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so a helper recording that selector will observe calls whose selector equals keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)")); the mutant uses selector transfer(address,address,uint256) instead, so a recorder can detect the different selector for some fuzzed inputs and therefore the observed selector differs.
change_summary: Change the call selector to use transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom so callee likely returns different success, altering the returned boolean behavior.
